title: Cubarsí v Puyol, Piqué and Ramos at the same age
checked: Barcelona v Manchester City, Champions League, 8 Dec 2026 (Foot Africa + UEFA list). Cubarsí born 22 Jan 2007 = 19 years 320 days. 139 Barcelona first-team games to 31 Oct 2026 and 23 Spain caps to 6 Oct 2026 (Wikipedia; so 'over one hundred and sixty'); La Liga 2024-25 and 2025-26, Copa del Rey 2024-25, Supercopa 2025 and 2026 (Wikipedia); 2026 World Cup winner, started all eight games, FIFA Young Player Award (FIFPro + DT Next + Fox). Puyol at the same age (27 Feb 1998): no first-team games, debut 2 Oct 1999 aged 21 (FC Barcelona + SI). Piqué (19 Dec 2006): on loan at Zaragoza from Man United (Bleacher Report + Wikipedia). Ramos (13 Feb 2006): first season at Real Madrid after signing aged 19 (Sevilla FC + Wikipedia); his exact game count is disputed between sources, so it is left out. 2010 World Cup ages from birth dates. Senior trophies only; Cubarsí's 2024 Olympic gold (under-23) is left out.

lines.text: When Barcelona host Manchester City on the eighth of December, Pau Cubarsí will be nineteen years and three hundred and twenty days old.
He's already a world champion. He started all eight games as Spain won the World Cup this summer.
And FIFA named him the tournament's best young player. The first defender ever to win it.
Over one hundred and sixty senior games for club and country. Six senior trophies.
Now Spain's legendary centre-backs at exactly the same age. Carles Puyol: February nineteen ninety-eight.
Barcelona first-team games? Zero. His debut didn't come until he was twenty-one.

scene.heading: PUYOL, 1998
scene.body: Still in Barcelona's reserves. First-team debut: Valladolid away, October 1999, aged 21.

lines.text: Gerard Piqué, December twenty oh-six: on loan at Real Zaragoza from Manchester United. No senior trophies.
Sergio Ramos, February twenty oh-six: in his first season at Real Madrid. Also no trophies yet.
So the twist: all four became world champions. Look at the ages.
Cubarsí got there four years before Piqué, and thirteen years before Puyol.

scene.title: Age when they won the World Cup

lines.text: So where does Cubarsí end up? Better than all three? Tell me in the comments.
